primitives.name: Feint to Snap Ball
primitives.verbatim_quote: (b) If, after the snapper-back has taken his position, he should voluntarily move the ball as if to snap it, whether he withholds it altogether or only momentarily, the ball is in play, and the scrimmage has begun.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_s': 'time of scrimmage initiation (s)', 'M_b': 'ball motion vector (m/s)', 'P_s': 'snapper-back position (m)', 'S_f': 'snap feint signal (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Snapper-back is on-side; voluntary motion implies intent to begin play.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_s < 0 or P_s is off-side, scrimmage invalid.

layer2.mapping: Feint maps to stochastic process where M_b triggers T_s, modeled as Markovian transition from pre-snap to post-snap state.
layer2.telemetry: Ball motion detection and timing validation

primitives.name: Snapper-back Off-side
primitives.verbatim_quote: (c) When snapping the ball back, the player so doing must be on-side, the hand or foot used in snapping the ball excepted.
primitives.assumptions: Player must be on-side at moment of snap; exception applies to snapping limb.

layer2.mapping: Off-side condition derived from spatial kernel of player position relative to boundary, triggering penalty kernel.
layer2.telemetry: Positional tracking and boundary crossing detection

primitives.name: False Start Deception
primitives.verbatim_quote: (d) If any player of the side in possession of the ball other than the snapper-back makes any deliberate attempt, by a false start or otherwise, to draw the opponents off-side, the ball, if then snapped, shall not be regarded as in play nor the scrimmage as begun.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_d': 'deception attempt amplitude (dimensionless)', 'T_d': 'deception duration (s)', 'S_b': 'snap signal (dimensionless)', 'I_p': 'opponent positional shift (m)'}
primitives.assumptions: Deception must be deliberate; snap invalid if deception occurs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If A_d > threshold and I_p > 0, scrimmage fails.

layer2.mapping: Deception modeled as adversarial signal injection into opponent state estimation, causing misalignment in I_p.
layer2.telemetry: Opponent movement deviation and deception signal correlation
